errata.orig: The FE model [RFC5812] has specified predefined (built-in) atomic data types: char, uchar, int16, uint16, int32, uint32, int64, uint64, string[N], string, byte[N], boolean, octetstring[N], float16, float32, and float64.
errata.correct: The FE model [RFC5812] has specified predefined (built-in) atomic data types: char, uchar, int16, uint16, int32, uint32, int64, uint64, string[N], string, byte[N], boolean, octetstring[N], float32, and float64.
errata.notes: According to RFC5812, floating data types can only be float32 or float64.
